text:
clare: Opening PR to modernize the Quickstart "Hello Desk" tutorial. Goal: replace bulky multi-step auth flow with `redwood login` helper, streamline Codespaces + local Docker examples, and fix three link redirects. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
omar: big 👍 on the login helper. can we show both flows: 1) `redwood login` (recommended) and 2) fallback env var for CI? people still run CI-only deploys.
clare: yes — short section for each. Login helper example will show a one-liner that writes to .env and a note about `source .env` for shell.
zane: for Codespaces, add a tiny note about forwarding ports and that `redwood login` will persist to the repo container, so recommend a temporary token. also include a k8s manifest snippet for teams that want to try first-run in a pod (minimal).
clare: adding Codespaces FAQ and a minimal k8s pod manifest (3 lines) under "Optional: run in Kubernetes". will pin container tag to `hello-desk:1.0.0` and put a sentence about fixing tags for Dedicated/private installs.
docs-bot: preview site created: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/612 (building) :hourglass:
omar: nit: in the auth paragraph prefer the phrasing "recommended: redwood login" in bold and keep fallback phrasing short. also mention the env var name `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and that `REDWOOD_LEGACY_TOKEN` is deprecated.
clare: updated wording and added a migration note: "REDWOOD_LEGACY_TOKEN deprecated; use REDWOOD_API_KEY or `redwood login`". also trimmed curl to one small example.
zane: add a Troubleshooting bullet for port conflicts in Codespaces (users frequently hit 404 because ports not forwarded). small checklist: forward port, allow public preview, check container logs.
clare: added troubleshooting checklist + tiny log command `docker logs hello-desk` and k8s `kubectl logs`. included expected health output: `{\"status\":\"ok\",\"model\":\"hello-desk\"}` so beginners know it's healthy.
docs-bot: link-check: found 2 redirects -> auto-fixed in commit (sha: c9b1d4) :white_check_mark:
preview-bot: preview redeployed for commit c9b1d4 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
omar: quick scan looks good. small code style nit: prefer fenced blocks with ```bash for shell snippets.
clare: switched blocks to fenced ```bash and squashed WIP commits. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612
ci-bot: lint: passed; smoke tests: passed; integration link-check: passed (sha: c9b1d4) :white_check_mark:
zane: approved, pushing merge after CI green. thanks for keeping the Codespaces piece short and useful. :tada:
clare: merged to main at 3734568120 — thanks all!
